meta.description: Guidances extraites des communiqués de résultats (8-K Item 2.02, SEC)

guidances.libelle: chiffre d'affaires net total des produits
guidances.citation: The Company expects the PMO franchise to remain strong and is updating its full-year guidance ranges, raising the low end of total net product revenue guidance by $50.0 million to a range of $1.25 billion to $1.3 billion.

guidances.libelle: dépenses combinées non-GAAP R&D et SG&A
guidances.citation: The Company also narrows its full-year combined non-GAAP R&D and SG&A expenses, lowering the high end of expense guidance by $25.0 million to a range of $800 million to $825 million.
